sloka: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे राक्षसश्च विभीषणः ।उत्पत्योत्पत्य ददृशुस्तां पुरीं शुभदर्शनाम् ।। ६.१२६.५३ ।।
transliteration: tataste vānarāḥ sarve rākṣasaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।utpatyotpatya dadṛśustāṁ purīṁ śubhadarśanām ।। 6.126.53 ।।

translations.english: "In these countries was a Rakshasa, called Viradha of gigantic size who was killed by me. There is an ascetic woman Anasuya practicing virtues whom you saw."
